question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**very**" is the most appropriate to use in this context.
 
• "**Very**" is used to emphasize the degree of something, in this case, Charlie's poverty.
 
• "**Nicely**" means in a pleasant or satisfactory manner, and it doesn't fit the context.
 
• "**Finally**" means after a long time, typically when an effort, journey, or process has reached a conclusion, and it doesn't fit the context.
 
• "**Properly**" means in a manner that is satisfactory or appropriate, and it doesn't fit the context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *It is about a boy named Charlie who is very__ poor.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Nicely**: In a pleasant or satisfactory manner, not suitable for this context.
 
• **Finally**: After a long time, usually when an effort, journey, or process has come to an end, not suitable in this context.
 
• **Properly**: In a manner that is satisfactory or appropriate, not suitable in this context.
